name: Template empty
purpose: What a whole PAGE says when it has nothing to show. Empty-state draws the empty REGION; this template supplies the three things only a page can know: the HEIGHT the region must hold, the page FURNITURE that stays visible around it (on a no-results page the search box and the filter chips are the entire recovery route), and the COUNT LINE that says what the page is empty OF.

Layer-2 rows have no ruled artefact form; this file ships in the library's grammar on the brief's PROPOSED convention (s182-D2, the Kpi-tile precedent). No registration was performed: no CATEGORIES entry, no MIGRATED_SNIPPETS entry, no component-types.json membership, no canon.css block, no _rulings.json line, no gen_kg_edges.py run, no git operation. Deleting this pair costs nothing because nothing points at it.
$layer-note: The wave-5 and wave-6 briefs PROPOSED the meta key `layer`. meta.schema.json is additionalProperties:false with patternProperties '^\\$' only, so a bare `layer` key FAILS probe P-1 (probe_meta_schema.py). `$layer` is the legal form and is what is used here - the correction #210 wave-5 lane C reported, carried forward, not re-discovered. A `$`-prefixed key is an ANNOTATION by the schema's own grammar: if Layer-2 membership is meant to be queryable structure it wants a real enum property and a schema amendment. Still open, still Dave's.

$composes: Empty-state (.empty, .glyph, .gap and the link treatment - raw font-weight dropped), Data-grid (.dg-toolbar, .dgsearch, .dgs-clear, .fbar, .fchip), Stat-card (the results panel surface), Breadcrumbs + Headers (the page-header lock-up), Button (the page action and the first-run action, with its injected press-physics partial), Layout-utilities (.l-container / .l-stack / .l-row).

accessibility.roles: No invented roles. Each specimen is a <main> with an <h1>; the empty regions are <section aria-labelledby>; the filter chip bar is role="group" with an accessible name.
accessibility.keyboard: Tab order follows source order: breadcrumb, page action, search box, clear-search, each chip's remove control, then the single recovery action. Every chip remove control has a purposeful accessible name ('Remove the March 2026 filter').
accessibility.announcements: The count line is role="status" so a filter that empties the page announces the new count once. The empty region itself announces NOTHING - Empty-state's own rule: an empty region is a STATE, not an event.
accessibility.states: None. Nothing on this page is interactive beyond navigation.
accessibility.targets: MEASURED at 1400px: page and empty-block buttons 159x44, 135x44, 121x44. INHERITED SHORTFALLS, measured and NOT silently enlarged: Data-grid's .dgs-clear and .fchip .x are 24x24 - the source components' shipped geometry, reported for Dave rather than quietly changed by a template.
accessibility.$colourIsNeverAlone: Nothing on this page carries meaning by colour. The glyphs are aria-hidden decoration and every title carries the meaning in words.
accessibility.$knownDelta: Empty-state namespaces its action button `.ebtn` precisely so the `.btn` classname's type.css blast radius does not escape. This template uses `.btn`, because the page around it already carries Button atoms and two button families on one page is the collision class this wave keeps finding. The blast radius is DECLARED to the conductor rather than avoided.

antiPatterns: Letting the empty region collapse to its content. A page whose content region is only as tall as one sentence is a header and a hairline; the region must hold a height.
Hiding the filters when the filter matched nothing. The controls that caused the emptiness are the only route out of it.
Offering more than one action. Empty-state's own rule: an empty region is not a menu.
Making the no-results action a primary button. A no-results state offers the CHEAP way back, which is a link.
Writing a count line the page cannot substantiate. '0 of 1,284' is a claim about the unfiltered set and only the page knows it.

Inventing a spot illustration. The icon library has no spot-illustration set; the glyphs here are real library glyphs used decoratively, which is Empty-state's own declared compromise and its logged icon gap.
